title: Frame-time raw sample record (T06)
description: One continuous capture of frame presentation timestamps for a single scenario segment on the real RG477M. This is the RAW artefact: derived statistics are computed by tools/perf/ from these fields, never typed in by hand. See frametime-format.md for the prose spec of the clock source, measurement point, percentile algorithm and segment/caching fields.

run_id.description: Unique run id. One record per capture session (a session may contain several segments).

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 with explicit UTC offset, taken on the DEVICE clock at the START of the capture.

native_libs_sha256.description: SHA-256 of each native library shipped in the APK, keyed by lib name (e.g. lib/arm64-v8a/libmain.so).

panel_refresh_rate_hz.description: Physical panel refresh rate. If 120, the panel can present the same game frame twice; the dedup rule in frametime-format.md applies.

internal_render_width.description: Internal render target width actually used.

ui_resolution.description: UI resolution, if it is adapted separately from the internal render target.

fixed_resolution.description: True when this run used a fixed internal resolution with no dynamic scaling.

clock.description: Provenance of the timestamps. Must be filled for every record; a record with an unknown clock is not usable for PASS/FAIL.

source.description: POSIX clock id actually passed to clock_gettime(). CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW is preferred: it is not slewed by NTP and is not scaled by suspend.

clock.description: Concrete clock_gettime() clock id / Android API used, e.g. clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW).

monotonic_anchor_ns.description: First raw timestamp observed in this capture (ns, same clock as source).

wallclock_anchor_iso.description: Wall-clock time at the monotonic anchor, for cross-referencing logs.

suspend_aware.description: True if the clock keeps advancing across device sleep (CLOCK_BOOTTIME) or if the capture was stopped across sleep.

drift_correction.description: null when no correction was applied. Must state the method if any.

location.description: Exactly where the timestamp is taken, e.g. 'immediately after eglSwapBuffers() returns, on the render thread'.

method.description: e.g. 'eglSwapBuffers + clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW)' or 'Choreographer.FrameCallback' or 'Vulkan fence wait -> clock_gettime'.

timestamp_semantics.description: What the timestamp represents. 'present' is preferred for game-frame intervals.

overhead_ns.description: MEASURED cost of adding the instrumentation, not an estimate. If it was not measured, use -1 and record a limitation.

name.description: Human label of the scenario, e.g. 'combat-encounter-A'.

category.description: PROJECT.md requires movement, battle and cutscene to be measured separately, each >= 5 minutes.

load_boundary_policy.description: Boundary rule DECLARED BEFORE the run, e.g. 'exclude frames while a loading screen is visible; loading frames are reported separately in segment kind=loading'.

start_ns.description: Inclusive, same clock unit as clock.source.

kind.description: video = source-material video playback whose native frame rate may differ from the game frame rate; must be reported separately.

excluded_from_playing_stats.description: True when the segment is NOT gameplay (loading/warmup/video). The exclusion must be declared in load_boundary_policy BEFORE the run.

source_video_fps.description: Native frame rate of a source video segment, if it is a video asset.

state.description: cold = first run after install / first run after asset cache clear / first run after boot with cold page cache. warm = subsequent run with caches populated.

shader_compile_pause_ms.description: Measured first-compile shader stall for this run, if cold. Must be reported separately from warm-cache results.

samples.description: Ordered frame presentation records. Must be monotonically increasing in ts_ns.

ts_ns.description: Presentation timestamp in nanoseconds, same clock as clock.source.

game_frame_id.description: Monotonic id of the game frame that was rendered. Two consecutive samples with the SAME game_frame_id mean the same game frame was presented twice (repeat present) and MUST NOT count as two new game frames.

new_game_frame.description: False when this presentation repeats the previous game frame. Repeat presents are excluded from game-frame interval statistics; they are still recorded.

presented_content.description: What was actually presented. 'ui_overlay' and 'external_texture' are NOT new game frames.

input_to_present_ns.description: Latency from the input event that drove this frame to its presentation, when the input event can be attributed.

stats.description: Derived statistics. If present, MUST have been computed by tools/perf/ from samples with the algorithm documented in frametime-format.md; hand-typed values are not admissible.

p1_low_fps.description: 1% low, computed as (100 / P99 interval) by default. MUST NOT be presented as the same quantity as P99 interval; the formula is stated explicitly here.

limitations.description: Explicit statements of what this record does NOT establish.
